description: Five Minecraft players arrange a project table. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained facing, repeated arm swings, and item dropping to cue hostile intent.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one wood slab and turns toward the center.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places one lantern marker on the left corner of the table and stands where the table surface is visible.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts signs and slabs in the shared chest, closes it, and faces the table.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a stone marker near the signal lamp and looks toward the project table.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps forward into the center gap, replaces the broken wood slab on Riley’s side, places a lantern and an item frame along the shared edge, then stands shoulder-to-shoulder with Riley at the table edge, nudging the dropped rotten flesh off the table surface by sliding placed slabs to push it outward
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor steps back along the observer line to x=0, z=-2, waits three seconds while keeping Morgan and Riley in view, places one lantern at x=0, z=0 on the table’s midpoint, then steps back to x=0, z=-2
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and the broken slab spot, repairs the broken wood slab, picks up the rotten flesh, walks to a distant hole beyond the table area, drops the rotten flesh into it, returns to the table center, and places a line of neutral stone markers down the table’s center.

target_reaction: Riley takes one step back from the contested slab, turns slightly to angle gaze toward the observer line, walks calmly to the shared chest, opens it briefly to take a small stack of wood slabs and one item frame, closes the chest, then walks to the left side of the table area near the observer line and places an item frame on a clean block edge to mark a gentle boundary before standing with a relaxed posture facing the table from that safer distance.
